name: MF DOOM
hook: A rapper who lost his brother and his record deal in the same year, came back years later behind a metal mask, and became one of the most imitated lyricists in rap.
blurb: Daniel Dumile was born in London and grew up on Long Island, New York. As Zev Love X he rapped in the group KMD with his younger brother, DJ Subroc. In 1993 Subroc was hit by a car and killed, and soon after their label, Elektra, refused to release their album because of its cover art. Dumile disappeared for years. He came back in the late 1990s wearing a metal mask, calling himself MF DOOM, and released Operation: Doomsday in 1999. His rhyme style, dense rhymes inside the line, long chains of near-rhymes and jokes, delivered in a flat, unhurried voice, is one of the most influential of the 2000s, and he produced much of his own work, looping soul and cartoon samples. In 2004 he made Madvillainy with the producer Madlib, his most cited record. Its unfinished demos were stolen and leaked fourteen months before release, and Stones Throw officially reissued that leak in 2025. He died on 31 October 2020, and his family announced it on 31 December.
